boe_iadb.rate_limit_rule: Akamai bot manager: ONE request per lane with all codes batched, identifiable User-Agent, >=2 s between requests, never parallel; an unknown code fails the whole request
boe_iadb.robots_note: boeapps is disallowed for generic crawlers; the IADB is the BoE's own programmatic export — use a named User-Agent and low frequency

batches.rule: one request per batch, CSVF=TT for descriptions on backfill, TN thereafter; ≥2 s between batches; an invalid code returns HTML (text/html) for the whole batch → mark degraded and bisect

boe_iadb.max_codes_per_request: unknown (DeepSeek claims 300, unverified); use 20–30 and test incrementally; 75 parallel triggered Akamai
hardening: save raw CSV snapshot per request
check Content-Type: HTML instead of CSV → status degraded, do not parse
exponential backoff with jitter, never parallel
on failure keep last good JSON as stale, never synthesize
dead-man switch after 2 consecutive lane failures
GitHub Actions runner IPs may be blocked harder than a home IP → identifiable UA + manual escape hatch
boe_iadb.fallback: FRED IUDSOIA/Bank Rate/gilt yields as degraded fallback for RATES ONLY (never for reserves/APF)
boe_iadb.code_map_source: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/statistics/tables — full Bankstats code map (hrefs carry full codes incl. LPM/RPM/RPW prefixes)

operations_calendar.apf_sales_note: BoE APF sales Mondays — DMO and APF supply both drain reserves on settlement

dmo.note: per-event results (nominal, bid-to-cover, tail, avg yield, settlement); NEP daily cash is NOT public in machine form (Perplexity note 2026-09-08 agrees)

fred_fallback.note: used only if IADB lane fails twice

str_by_operation.freq: weekly (updated Thursday ~14:15 London after the op; last-modified 2026-09-03)
str_by_operation.fields: date, amount allotted, number of bidders/participants

apf_gilt_sales.feeds: apf_gilt_sales_by_bucket → QT_ACCELERATION with the executed pace, not only Δ APF loan

boe_operations_xlsx.rule: same courtesy rule as the IADB: sequential, ≥ 2.5 s apart, identifiable User-Agent; keep raw copies in logs/gbp/raw

boe_ops.verified: 2026-09-10 (columns opened; STR 202 ops since 2022-10-06 without participants; ILTR bids/alloc/spread by level A/B/C; APF sales by ISIN with settlement date since 2022-11; maturity profile 46 gilts, stock £489bn)

boe_ops.rule: one GET per file, ≥2.5 s apart, identifiable UA (Akamai)

D1C/D8B/D2.1A cannot be exported as XML

ways_and_means.label: Ways and Means advances to HM Government

apf_loan.label: Loan to Asset Purchase Facility
apf_loan.note: code to locate in IADB tree Assets; Apr-2026 value 553158

tfsme.label: TFSME aggregate drawings (financed by reserve creation)

government_account.label: HMG deposits at BoE — NOT published as a separate Weekly Report line
government_account.equivalence_note: fiscal account is read in the fiscal block (ONS), not here
government_account.note: search IADB Liabilities tree; if found, restores the TGA term and Net Liquidity can be reinstated
government_account.weekly_report_confirmed_absent: B1.1.2 columns (Bankstats tables page, 2026-09-08): liabilities = STR? no — reserves, notes, FX public securities; no HMG deposits line. Monthly candidate: table B2.2 (central bank contribution to MFI balance sheet, public sector deposits) — Phase 3

osf_lending_usage.label: Operational Standing Facility — lending, average outstanding by maintenance period
osf_lending_usage.verified: 2026-09-08 IADB CSVF=TT; Nov-2025 MP = 29, Feb-2026 MP = 71 (repo-spike episodes)
osf_lending_usage.role: functional discount window; > 0 in a maintenance period = a firm paid Bank Rate + 25bp
osf_lending_usage.note: published per MPC maintenance period (~6-weekly), lagged — event flag, not a weekly gauge

dwf_usage.label: Discount Window Facility usage
dwf_usage.note: DWF usage is published with a long lag (quarterly, 5-quarter delay) — event flag only

ctrf.label: Contingent Term Repo Facility (CTRF)
ctrf.role: emergency/episodic backstop — any value > 0 is an event flag

fx_public_securities.label: Foreign currency public securities issued (liability)
fx_public_securities.note: BoE's own FX bonds; not sterling liquidity

osf_deposit_usage.label: Operational Standing Facility — deposit, average outstanding by maintenance period

repo_offset.note: demand-driven: level is not a policy signal; watch abrupt changes

policy_balance_sheet.label: Policy Balance Sheet (assets)
policy_balance_sheet.note: NOT 'Net Liquidity': the Weekly Report has no HMG deposits line, so the USD WALCL−TGA−RRP construct is not buildable weekly. Primary weekly liquidity reading = reserves (RPWB56A) + price (SONIA − Bank Rate).

repo_dependence_ratio.note: share of reserves supplied by repo (BoE: ~1/4 in Mar 2026). Informational while SONIA − Bank Rate < 0; escalates only with price confirmation

reserves_vs_pmrr_ceiling.note: distance to PMRR ceiling; the clock to watch during QT

primary_absolute.range_name: PMRR (BoE preferred minimum range of reserves)
primary_absolute.source: BoE Bank Insights 'Resilience and readiness across the SMF', 27 Mar 2026: latest survey £365–515bn (previous £375–540bn, Saporta Nov 2025; £385–540bn Q1-2025 survey)
primary_absolute.in_range_note: inside PMRR = transition zone (informational WATCH, never stress by itself); scarcity requires PRICE confirmation (SONIA − Bank Rate ≥ 0 persistent)
primary_absolute.review_rule: re-check PMRR each BoE survey / Market Notice; store history of range revisions

secondary_absolute_v43.origin: GBP-ICC v4.3 methodology 2.1 — reference only, pre-PMRR

reserves.percentile_note: NO rolling percentile on the reserves LEVEL (non-stationary under QT). Percentiles only on stationary transforms: reserves_wow_pct, spreads.

secondary_absolute.origin: v4.3 netLiq Δ: <1% green, 1–2% amber, >2% red (as absolute change)

qt_pace.origin: v0.2.1: 26-week average weekly Δ APF vs announced £70bn/yr (≈ −1,346/w); WATCH ×1.25, STRESS ×1.75

repo_dependence_ratio.note: quantity alone never escalates in a demand-driven framework

derived_v04.str_net_daily: STR allocated at operation date (+) − matured (−)
derived_v04.apf_redemptions_next_12m: APF nominal by maturity date (HMT ↔ BoE, no reserve effect)
derived_v04.exchequer_residual_weekly / _4w: ΔR − ΔSTR − ΔLTR − ΔAPF loan − ΔTFSME − ΔW&M + ΔNotes (Weekly Report identity)
derived_v04.components_v04: shadow: repo_net_5d_pct, apf_sales_5d_pct (flows), repo_dependence_ops_pct (level) as % of reserves — not in the live score until the replay

fiscal.equivalence_note: No daily/weekly Exchequer account is published in machine-readable form (DMO daily cash flow is PDF). ONS Public Sector Finances give central government cash requirement, expenditure and receipts monthly (~3-week lag). Gilt/T-bill issuance from DMO by event (pending).

psnb_ex.label: PS: Net borrowing excl. PS banks £m CPNSA

interest_paid_private.label: PS: interest & dividends paid to private sector & RoW £m

psnd.label: Public sector net debt (PSND ex) £bn
psnd.note: JW2P is interest paid, NOT debt — do not relabel

dmo_gilt_auction.label: DMO gilt auction: nominal, bid-to-cover, tail (bp), avg yield, settlement date

net_spending.sign: positive = net creation of NFA proxy (before issuance)

derived.mmt_note: Spending creates NFA; taxes destroy NFA; gilt issuance (CGNCR financing) drains reserves without changing NFA. Monthly resolution only — do not read intra-month.

cgncr_role.note: CGNCR = cash requirement (issuance drain proxy), NOT MMT net spending. net_spending = cg_expenditure − cg_receipts stays the NFA flow. Keep both separate; store vintages (ONS revises).

influence_cap.note: fiscal layer cannot flip regime alone (monthly, 3-week lag): contribution capped at ±0.5 of block score

derived_v04.gilt_issued_daily: Δ TOTAL_AMOUNT_IN_ISSUE between D1A snapshots (+ new gilts first issued after the previous snapshot)
derived_v04.gilt_redeemed_private / gilt_redeemed_ap: gilt vanishing at redemption; split by APF nominal (profile)
derived_v04.tbill_issued / tbill_matured: D2.2D by issue and maturity date (dense daily)
derived_v04.coupons_private_paid: last 60 days, estimated from the current snapshot × coupon/2 × private share
derived_v04.net_issuance_private_daily / net_issuanc: − gilts − T-bills + private redemptions + T-bill maturities + private coupons (daily / 5 sessions)
derived_v04.*_next_4w: calendars from D1A dividend and redemption dates
derived_v04.components_v04: shadow: net_issuance_5d_pct, exchequer_residual_4w_pct + v0.3 net_spending_band_x_z; CGNCR remains the monthly anchor

m4_lending_ex.label: M4 lending excluding intermediate OFCs (M4Lex) — amounts outstanding SA

m4_lending_ex_change.label: M4Lex — monthly change SA (loans create deposits: primary MMT transmission flow)

lending_to_individuals.label: Net lending to individuals ex SLC — amounts outstanding SA

lending_to_individuals_change.label: Net lending to individuals — monthly change SA

secured_lending_change.label: Net secured lending on dwellings — monthly change SA

mortgage_approvals.label: Mortgage approvals for house purchase — number SA (leading indicator)

consumer_credit_change.label: Consumer credit ex SLC — monthly net change SA

pnfc_lending.label: MFI sterling net lending to PNFCs — amounts outstanding SA

pnfc_lending_change.label: Net lending to PNFCs — monthly change SA

household_m4.label: Household sector M4 holdings (deposits) — amounts outstanding SA

new_lending_effective_rate.label: Effective rate on new lending (IUM/CFM family)

transmission_signal.rule: green if >=3 of {m4_lending up, pnfc_lending up, household_deposits up, sonia_dispersion stable}; red if >=3 opposite; NO SIGNAL if valid_series < 3

v01_codes_rejected.LPMVWYL: was M2 EMU changes, not M4 lending
v01_codes_rejected.LPMVWYS: sight deposits all sectors, not household

deposit_rate.label: Rate paid on reserves = Bank Rate (no separate deposit rate)

bond_2y.label: 2Y par yield — NOT in IADB par-yield family (5/10/20 only)
bond_2y.fallback: curve slope uses 10Y − 5Y and 5Y − Bank Rate

gilt_gc_repo.label: Sterling GC repo rate (overnight)
gilt_gc_repo.source: no free official series known; BoE/vendor — mark unavailable rather than estimate

osf_ceiling.label: OSF lending rate = Bank Rate + 25bp
osf_ceiling.role: reference ceiling: SONIA or GC above OSF = real stress

overnight_minus_policy_bps.role: PRIMARY stress spread (Bank Rate is paid on all reserves = floor)
overnight_minus_policy_bps.note: normally negative (SONIA a few bp below Bank Rate); stress = closing toward 0 or crossing above

secondary_absolute.origin: BoE floor framework; asymmetric (SONIA normally −3/−5bp). v4.3 |x| 5/15 symmetric was wrong. Reviewers: −1bp too sensitive as trigger → early flag only; ≥0 persistent = friction

gc_minus_policy_bps.origin: Nov-2025 gilt repo spike ~+30bp handled with record STR (Saporta); status pending until a GC source exists

regime.weights_note: v0.2 approved by Sander 2026-09-08: CB 0.45 / rates 0.35 / fiscal 0.10 / banking 0.10 (SMF: reserves quantity endogenous, price is the scarcity proof). To be recalibrated later with live history (see regime.calibration).

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: reserves BELOW PMRR floor (365bn) AND overnight_minus_policy_bps >= 0 persistent (3 sessions or weekly mean)
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: reserves within/above PMRR AND overnight_minus_policy_bps >= 0 persistent (SONIA pinned at/above Bank Rate while reserves ample); −1bp single print = early flag only, not a regime
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

orthogonal_flags.TRANSMISSION_FAILURE: banking.transmission_signal == RED while reserves within/above PMRR
orthogonal_flags.QT_ACCELERATION: abs(qt_pace) > announced APF reduction pace (annual remit / 52) × 1.25; needs apf_loan verified
orthogonal_flags.REPO_DEPENDENCE_STRESS: repo_dependence_ratio >= WATCH AND (overnight_minus_policy_bps >= 0 persistent OR gc_minus_policy_bps >= STRESS OR osf_lending_usage > 0)
orthogonal_flags.GILT_SUPPLY_STRESS: DMO auction tail >= p90 (156 events) OR bid-to-cover < 1.5 (pending DMO source)
orthogonal_flags.FISCAL_BIG_MONTH: abs(net_spending z-score 24m) >= 2 (sign matters more than weight)

calibration.method: after >=26 weeks of live data: grid over weights, score by agreement with price-confirmed stress episodes (SONIA−Bank Rate ≥ 0, GC spikes) and false-positive rate; changes logged in regime changelog

regime.qt_announced_pace_note: £70bn/yr APF reduction (Sep-2025 MPC) / 52 ≈ £1.35bn/w; re-set after the Sep-2026 MPC decision

dual.status: calibrated by replay 2026-09-09 (engine v0.3, era 2022-11-01, 201 weeks)

central_bank.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

fiscal.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

dual.rule: three regimes per currency (engine v0.3): central_bank and fiscal from their block score with era-calibrated entry/exit cuts on the 7-day mean score; general = agreement only (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN, partial or conflict → NEUTRAL labelled); percentile windows anchored to era_start; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

regime.composite_note: weights (4 blocks) now produce the desk composite score for context; the reported regime is the general regime (central bank + treasury)

dual_v02.rule: three regimes per currency: central_bank (block score), fiscal (block score), general = agreement (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN); a conflict is resolved by the dual-weighted score against general_thresholds; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

status_rules.note: daily=4 covers weekends/holidays and the CORRA next-day publication

weekly.note: Thursday 16:30 WAT, after the Weekly Report (15:00 London = 14:00 UTC in BST)

daily.note: 11:30 WAT after IADB daily rates (SONIA published 09:00 London next day)

fiscal_seasonality.note: flag quarter-end, PAYE/VAT receipt days, DWP payment days, large gilt settlements — exclude from spread persistence and annotate fiscal prints

calendar.money_credit_release: ~1st business day of the month 09:30 London (data for month-2)
